Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Life changing!
This machine has been surprisingly easy to use. The controls are intuitive, and I was able to get started without spending much time reading the manual. The biggest surprise was the power — the treatment feels very similar to the shockwave sessions I've had at a physical therapy clinic, which really impressed me. I've been using it mainly for chronic hip pain, and after consistent treatments, I've noticed a significant reduction in pain and stiffness. I've now owned it for about five months, using it twice a week, and it has performed flawlessly — no issues at all, which says a lot about the build quality. One small thing worth mentioning: the shipping box is fairly large, but the machine itself is compact and easy to move around the house, so that's never been a problem.

    Shockis shockwave machine is outstanding
    Reviewed in the United States on July 31, 2026
    Color: Blue
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I am really pleased with this shockwave machine. I purchased it in June of 2026 and have been using it for nearly two months now. It works well and helps relieve my pain from a major lumbar surgery that has lingering numbness in my leg and foot. The cost of the machine has already been paid many times over compared to going to a practitioner with a shockwave machine that is over $100 per session. The machine is very heavy duty and comes with multiple tips for different parts of the body depending on what you are targeting. If you have questions on proper settings for what you are doing they are instructions in the unit plus you can always do an internet search for recommended settings. Finally, I had one issue went I overtightened the head to the gun and could not get it to twist back off. I contacted Shockis customer support for advice. They immediately responded and said since the machine was still under warranty they would ship a replacement part. I was really impressed with how they handled my issue. Finally, a separate recommendation I have is Amazon's replacement warranty plan that is $17 per month. This is a great backup plan for all your purchases especially on large costly items like this. It's well worth the peace of mind in my opinion.

    I spent quite a bit of time comparing different shockwave therapy machines on Amazon before choosing the SHOCKIS ST100, and I have to say, this unit made a strong impression from the moment it arrived.

    The first thing I noticed was the packaging. The outer shipping box was not just a regular Amazon box thrown together casually. It actually had reinforced plastic corner protectors, which immediately gave me the feeling that the company takes the product seriously. For a machine like this, where the internal parts and handpiece matter a lot, careful packaging says a lot about the brand. It made the whole purchase feel more premium before I even started using the machine.

    Once I opened it, the machine itself felt solid and professional. It does not feel like a cheap home-use gadget or a simple massage device. One of the biggest advantages for me is that it is portable. I can move it around the house easily and use it wherever it is most comfortable. I do not need to buy a separate cart, stand, or operating table, which saves both space and money.

    The part that impressed me most was the DLC-treated projectile. After doing some research, I learned that DLC, or Diamond-Like Carbon, is not a simple surface coating. It is a more advanced treatment process, and applying it to such a small projectile can require multiple processing steps. That also means the projectile itself needs to have strong base quality to handle the treatment properly.

    A DLC-treated projectile does not need lubrication during braking or storage, and it can also improve energy transfer efficiency. The wear resistance is also much better compared with ordinary components. This made me feel much more confident that the SHOCKIS ST100 is not just another basic home-use machine. It feels much closer to professional clinic-level equipment.

    After using the SHOCKIS ST100 consistently on my plantar fasciitis area about 2–3 times per week, I started to notice a real difference. The morning heel pain that used to bother me almost every day has been greatly reduced, and walking feels much more comfortable than before. I still combine the treatments with stretching and strengthening exercises, but the ST100 has become an important part of my recovery routine. What I appreciate most is being able to use a professional-level shockwave device at home whenever I need it, without scheduling clinic appointments or driving back and forth for each session. Considering how expensive professional shockwave treatments can be, this machine has already saved me a significant amount of time and money while giving me the flexibility to stay consistent with my therapy.

    Overall, I am very satisfied with the SHOCKIS ST100. The careful packaging, portable design, strong energy output, and DLC projectile all make it stand out from many other shockwave machines on Amazon. It feels like a professional-grade device at a surprisingly good value, and I would recommend it to anyone looking for a serious shockwave therapy machine for home use.

    I’ve been a physical therapist running my own treatment studio for years, and I’ve now used this shockwave therapy machine for almost four straight months. During this time, I’ve treated all kinds of clients-people with plantar fasciitis, De Quervain’s tendinitis, chronic calf tightness, long-term shoulder issues, and more. Across all these cases, the results have been consistently impressive. The machine delivers strong, deep, and stable pulses, and the treatment effects show very clearly in client’s pain reduction and mobility improvement. One of the best parts is how easy it is to operate. Everything is straightforward, reliable, and designed with real clinical use in mind, which is something I deeply appreciate after trying multiple devices over the years.

    What truly sets this machine apart is the knob control system. This feature alone has made my treatment sessions smoothly and far more precise. Every client has a different pain tolerance and sensitivity level, so being able to start at a low level and gradually increase the intensity until we reach their ideal therapeutic range is extremely important. With the knob, I can make smooth, continuous adjustment-without interrupting my workflow. It avoids the inconvenience of having to use a touchscreen when my hands have gel on them, which was always an annoyance with my previous device. The knob allows me to adjust energy output and frequency quickly, safely, and accurately, and it generally improves my ability to deliver personalized therapy.

    Another advantage is how portable and reliable this machine is. I’ve carried it to many in-home treatment visits for clients who have mobility issues or prefer receiving therapy at home. The device is compact, easy to pack, and surprisingly lightweight considering how powerful it is. The output is not only strong but also extremely stable-far better than the last shockwave machine I used, even though the price of the two machines wasn’t that different. To put it in perspective, 5 bar on my previous machine didn’t even feel as strong as the 3.5 bar on this one.That alone made me realize the value of buying from a company that doesn’t inflate or fake their specs. Since switching to this machine, I’ve had more consistent results, shorter treatment times, and happier clients.

    Finally, I want to highlight the customer service team, because they deserve real credit. When I first received the machine, I had a few questions about its operation and setting. Their team responded quickly-always within 24 hours. They didn’t just give simple answers; they provided detailed explanations and even sent video demonstrations to make sure I understood everything clearly. Their patience and professionalism gave me a lot of confidence in both the product and the brand. After months of daily use, I can honestly say this device has become one of the most important tools in my studio. It’s powerful, honest in its specifications, highly practical, easy to operate, and backed by excellent support. For anyone running a therapy practice or offering professional treatments, this machine is absolutely worth having.

    I’m 52, and I’ve always liked staying active. I’m not trying to win any races, but I do like getting a few runs in during the week, taking long walks, and going on hikes when I can. About two years ago, plantar fasciitis started giving me a hard time, and honestly, it was a real pain.

    ﻿

    The worst part was the morning. I’d get out of bed and those first few steps were brutal—like my heel was stepping right onto a rock. Some days I would kind of hobble around the house for the first 10 or 15 minutes before my foot loosened up. After a run, or even after standing around too long, the bottom of my foot would get tight and sore, especially around the heel and arch. Sitting for a while didn’t help either. I’d get up from my desk and have to take a few awkward steps before I felt normal again. Not fun at all.

    ﻿

    I had shockwave therapy done at a clinic before, and it helped, but the cost added up fast. At some point I figured, why keep paying for every visit when I could put that money toward a solid machine at home? I picked the Shockis ST100 because it looked and operated the most like the equipment I had seen at the clinic. It didn’t feel like some random massage gadget—it looked like the real deal.

    ﻿

    After using it for several treatment sessions, I’m glad I bought it. The machine feels sturdy, the controls make sense, and I like that I can dial the intensity up or down without guessing. I’m not saying plantar fasciitis disappears overnight, because it definitely doesn’t, but after each course of use, my foot has felt a little better and a little less angry. My mornings are easier now, and I don’t feel as much tightness after being active.

    ﻿

    I did run into one small hiccup while using it, but the manual made it easy to find the right person to contact . Their support was great—friendly, quick to respond, and they actually seemed to know what they were talking about. That gave me a lot more peace of mind with the product.

    ﻿

    Overall, I’m very happy with the Shockis ST100. It’s not cheap, but for me, it has been worth it. If you’re dealing with plantar fasciitis and want a serious at-home option, this machine is definitely worth a look.

Product Description

Meet SHOCKIS, a versatile shockwave therapy machine designed for reliable output across 1–8 BAR and 1–21 Hz. Use it as a shock wave therapy device for deep tissue percussion, trigger-point work, athletic warm-ups, and cooldowns. The digital interface lets you fine-tune intensity and cadence, while interchangeable applicators switch quickly from broad coverage to focused pressure—ideal for at-home recovery or light professional environments that value durable equipment. As a complement to a muscle stimulator for pain relief therapy routine, SHOCKIS helps with common tightness and discomfort patterns, including hip pain relief, glutes, hamstrings, calves, shoulders, and lower back. References to related terminology such as neumann wave therapy and mansculpt wave therapy are included solely for shopper context and discoverability within common search language.
